description: This file defines a Console class for logging and displaying messages in a web page, including styling and ANSI color support. It also exports certain functions and symbols for external use.

classes.name: Console
classes.description: A class providing a web-based console for logging, warnings, errors, and styling with ANSI colors.

methods.name: _createElement
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a DOM element with specified tag and id, appending it to a host element.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message to the console with formatted colors.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Displays a warning message with a warning icon and styled background.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Displays an error message with styled background.

methods.name: injectAnsiColorCSS
methods.description: Injects CSS styles for ANSI color codes into the document.

methods.name: format_colors
methods.description: Formats a string with ANSI escape codes into HTML span elements with corresponding styles.
